name: guest-report-egress
observable: count of requests resolving to a host other than the installation origin, across a full page lifecycle including the hidden-page flush
binary_note: data either leaves the installation or it does not
anchor_note: Re-anchored 2026-10-19: the U2 anchor was written before the module existed and guessed a one-line sendBeacon call. The real code wraps the body in a Blob. A drifted anchor patches nothing, so the canary would have been a clean build and the lane's credential would have recorded a detection that never happened.
